title: Generator task (SPEC 5.2)
description: A task the client's model writes to the brief and hands in with submit_task (SPEC 5.2, D42). What the schema cannot say, filters.structure_errors checks: five different options, distractors for exactly the four wrong options, a non-empty hint, trap ids from the catalog.

core_idea.description: The mathematical core before the story: the idea and why the answer is what it is.

design_thought_process.description: How the story and each trap were designed.

question.description: The task text the student reads.

hint.description: One leading question or first step; it must not give the answer away.

distractors.description: One entry for each of the four wrong options, none for correct_answer.

trap.description: Trap id from the trap catalog: the mistake that leads to this option.

text.description: Shown to the student after choosing this wrong option.
